stratifications: age group (children 0-15 yrs and adults >15 yrs)
description: A deterministic mathematical model (SVEIIm) to describe the transmission dynamics of measles stratified into two age groups: children (0-15 yrs) and adults (above 15). The model incorporates monitored and un-monitored vaccination for children and a catch-up vaccination program for adults to evaluate the impact of these approaches on measles eradication.
